says: Alice founds a Team alone and authors its rules (Instructions) and its knowledge as two Team sources. She publishes a first environment edition that pins the knowledge revision, then publishes the rules revision as a source on its own. She publishes a second environment whose edition derives from the exact digest of the first and adds the rules revision as an explicit change, and only then adopts that edition for the Team as a separate request. Each step answers with its own record: the source keeps its revision digest, each edition its own digest and environment id, and the adoption names the exact edition it adopted. A preparation composed from the adopted environment names the adoption record in its request and composes exactly the pinned rules and knowledge revisions. Publishing the edition must not adopt it, and adopting must not rewrite the edition or the source revision.
